text:
Jordan (Partnerships): Heads-up — MerchantLane just dropped final co-marketing assets into the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/merchantlane-assets. Need quick QA on logo lockup, hero CTA, marketplace thumbnail sizing, and quote clearance. Can we review before EOD? cc @Sarah @Alex @Maria
Sarah M. (Growth): Thanks. Quick checklist from my side: logos (PNG/SVG/AI), quote copy + contact, partner description (1-2 sentences), marketplace tile (1200x628 recommended) and alt text. Do we have MerchantLane brand guidelines? :eyes:
Jordan (Partnerships): They included a brand.pdf in the folder and a ZIP of logos. They prefer the CTA text to be "Try on Redwood" vs our usual "Get started" — is that ok? Link: https://drive.redwood/merchantlane-assets/brand.pdf
Alex D. (Design): I can do the hero/thumbnail work. MerchantLane asks for 16px clearspace around the mark. Their preferred lockup is partner-left / redwood-right. I'll mock two variants (CTA A/B).
Alex D. (Design): Mock snippet for alt and sizing: ```
.hero-cta {
  width: 1200px;
  height: 628px;
  padding: 24px;
}
/* alt suggestion */
alt = "MerchantLane + Redwood: deploy inference at scale"
```
Maria - Legal: Need a signed quote release for any partner testimonial. Also confirm the partner's legal entity is "MerchantLane, Inc." for attribution. Check their brand.pdf for trademark usage — avoid adding TM unless specified.
Sarah M. (Growth): I'll request the signed release and a one-line bio + preferred attribution. Also confirm whether they have an approved headshot for the quote (if they want one).
Jordan (Partnerships): Timeline: MerchantLane wants to publish Tue morning. Can we lock assets by tomorrow 10:00am PT? @Alex can you finalize tiles by EOD today? @Maria can you confirm legal clearance timeline?
Alex D. (Design): Yep — will upload two hero tiles and one square marketplace thumbnail (1200x1200) by 5pm. One tile with "Try on Redwood" and one with "Get started" for A/B. I'll include source SVGs and a PSD.
DesignBot: Reminder — marketplace thumbnail spec updated 2025-01: recommended 1200x1200 (sRGB), min 800x800; safe text area 90px from edges. Auto alt-text suggestion: "MerchantLane and Redwood joint solution for scalable LLM inference."
Maria - Legal: I can turn around the quote release review today if partner returns the signed doc. If they only provide an informal email, we need an explicit one-liner acceptance from their legal or PM. Expecting confirmation by EOD if partner is responsive.
Sarah M. (Growth): Pinged MerchantLane PM (cc'd) for signed quote and final one-line description. Also asked if they have any brand color overrides for co-branded assets.
Jordan (Partnerships): One minor brand ask from them — their design team prefers the Redwood mark on white background for the marketplace thumbnail. Alex, can you produce a white-bg variant?
Alex D. (Design): Yep will produce white-bg + dark-bg variants. I'll keep logo clearspace consistent and export @2x for retina.
Sarah M. (Growth): Also note accessibility: alt text and CTA text need to be screen-reader-friendly. Suggest alt: "MerchantLane and Redwood joint solution for scalable LLM inference." Happy to tweak copy once I see draft.
Jordan (Partnerships): Great. Tasks: Alex — 2 hero tiles + 1 square thumbnail (white & dark variants). Sarah — obtain signed quote + partner description + alt text confirm. Maria — confirm quote release & trademark usage. We reconvene 10:00am PT tomorrow if anything is outstanding. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Alex D. (Design): Uploaded drafts to the folder: https://drive.redwood/merchantlane-assets/designs — feedback welcome.
Sarah M. (Growth): Got it. Pinged their PM for legal signature. Will update thread when received.
Maria - Legal: Confirmed logo files include vector AI/SVG. Trademark note: do not add ® unless partner provides assets with it.
Jordan (Partnerships): Closing loop for now — we'll target Tue publish pending the signed quote. If any blocker, add to this thread. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :eyes:
